title.zh: High-k 材料：物理更厚，电学更薄

subtitle.zh: 维持栅控、降低隧穿漏电，也能提高电容密度
subtitle.en: Maintain gate control, reduce tunneling leakage and increase capacitance density

body.zh: High-k 可用较大的物理厚度实现较小 EOT
body.en: High-k provides lower EOT with greater physical thickness

body.zh: 提高k 有利于 EOT 与电容，但还要兼顾能带、缺陷、热稳定性和电极兼容
body.en: Higher k benefits EOT and capacitance, but bands, defects, thermal stability and electrode compatibility also matter

body.zh: Oxygen Vacancy / Vt Shift / Mobility Loss / Gate Leakage / BTI / TDDB
body.en: Oxygen vacancy / Vt shift / mobility loss / gate leakage / BTI / TDDB

body.zh: 量测反馈：C-V /I-V/ EOT / TEM-EELS / XPS / BTI / TDDB
body.en: Metrology feedback: C-V / I-V / EOT / TEM-EELS / XPS / BTI / TDDB

body.zh: Gate、DRAM 与 MIM对 High-k的要求不同
body.en: Gates, DRAM and MIM have different High-k requirements
